password.noMatch: The passwords you entered do not match.

verify.invalidLink: The confirmation link is invalid or has expired.
verify.resent: If the address is still waiting for confirmation, we have sent you the link again.

setup.title: MindSift first-time setup
setup.subtitle: Initial administrator account & server configuration
setup.welcome: Welcome to your new MindSift instance. There is no user account in the database yet. Create the first server admin account now and choose the security settings.
setup.languageHint: For the sign-in page and new accounts; everyone can pick their own language later.
setup.privateHint: Nobody sees other users. Sharing and groups are off.
setup.organizationsHint: Users only see members of their organization. You start in an organization named after the instance.
setup.openHint: Open collaboration across the whole server.
setup.allowRegistrationHint: When off, new users can only join with an invite code or be created by an admin.
setup.sampleDataHint: Fills your account with sample thoughts, notes, task lists and shopping lists to try things out. No other users are created.
setup.finishWelcome: Your administrator account {{username}} was created at startup from ADMIN_USER and ADMIN_PASSWORD. Now choose the instance settings; you can change all of them later in the administration.

login.registrationClosed: Public registration is disabled. Access only with an account or an <invite>invite code</invite>.

register.hintApproval: After you register, an administrator approves your account.
register.hintVerify: You will get an email to confirm your address.
register.hintDomainApproval: Addresses from {{domains}} get in right away; an administrator approves other accounts.
register.hintVerifyFirst: {{hint}} You confirm your address by email first.
register.pending: Your account is waiting for an administrator's approval.

forgot.sent: If an account with this email address exists, we have sent you a link to reset your password. It is valid for one hour.
forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter your account's email address. We will send you a link to set a new password.

reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password now.
reset.failed: The password could not be changed
reset.title: Set a new password
reset.intro: Afterwards you are signed out everywhere and sign in with the new password.

consent.title: {{client}} wants to access your MindSift
consent.signedInAs: Signed in as {{name}}. Access works as it does for you; settings stay locked.
consent.returnTo: Afterwards you return to {{host}}. The connection is listed under Settings → API keys, where you can revoke it at any time.
consent.otherAccount: Sign in with a different account
consent.unknownHost: Careful: once allowed, access goes to {{host}}. That is none of the known AI services (claude.ai, chatgpt.com) and not your own computer. Anybody can call themselves “{{client}}” – only allow this if you set up the connection yourself.
